senses.gloss: f. pl. (= ענקלקלות; ענקל, dimin. of עֲנָק; cmp. עוּנְקְלָא) little beads (of a neclace), a name for undeveloped grapes.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 1:8">Orl. I, 8</cite>; expl. Y. ib. 61ᶜ top <he>ענבים שלקו עד וכ׳</he> grapes which were smitten before they had grown to one-third of the normal size; (oth. opin.) <he>אפי׳ לקו משהביאו וכ׳</he> even if they were smitten after having reached one-third of the normal size; ib. (as an abbreviation, <cite ref="N00351"><he>נוטריקון</he></cite>) <he>ע̇נ̇בין דלק̇ו תל̇תיהון</he> grapes smitten in the first of their three stages. Sifra K’dosh., ch. V, Par. 3.
